explanation: Seed plants are the most plentiful plants in the biosphere. A protective seed coat and stored food within the seed allow the plant embryo to survive harsh environmental conditions during extended dormancy. Seed plants are heterosporous, featuring drought-resistant pollen grains and ovules that develop into seeds. Seed plants are categorized into two groups: Gymnosperms (non-flowering plants) and Angiosperms (flowering plants).

questions.q: What features of a seed allow plant embryos to survive harsh conditions and dormancy?
opts: A protective seed coat and stored food
